title: Rotary Switch
text: Switch parameter to set values on dial, {Label} sets Block label position; {Connection} sets the block parameter value to connect parameter value connection, {States} sets the position labels and values scalar and character and {Enumerated Data Type} sets the state values and labels using an enumerated data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Block parameter value to connect parameter value connection options

params.name: States
params.values: Position labels and values scalar and character vector

params.name: Enumerated Data Type
params.values: Specify state values and labels using an enumerated data type off (default) | on

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Top (default) | Bottom | Hide
